intro: You will reconstruct the thesis, reasons and implicit assumptions, distinguishing evaluation from data.

texto: Distinguish the evaluative thesis from the data that support it and from assumptions about cause and effect. **Riktignok** concedes a point; **likevel** introduces the main argument. Ask what evidence would change the conclusion.

piezas.titulo: A column about library opening hours.

frases.estudio: Biblioteket bør holde åpent en time lenger på tirsdager. Flere studenter arbeider på dagtid, og besøksloggen viser økt trafikk mellom klokka sju og åtte. Riktignok koster ekstra bemanning penger, men én kveld i uka kan gi flere tilgang uten å endre hele ukeplanen. Påstanden forutsetter at kveldspersonalet er tilgjengelig.
frases.alumno: The library should stay open one hour longer on Tuesdays. Several students work during the day, and the visitor records show more activity between seven and eight. It is true that extra staff cost money, but one evening a week can widen access without changing the whole weekly timetable. The proposal presupposes that staff are available in the evening.

pregunta.texto: What condition does the proposal presuppose?

opciones.texto: That staff are available in the evening
opciones.explicacion: The text presents it as an assumption of the proposal.

opciones.texto: That the weekly timetable is removed

pregunta.texto: Analyse an opinion text: identify its thesis, a reason, a concession and an unproven assumption.

textos: Forfatteren mener at biblioteket bør holde åpent lenger. Besøksloggen brukes som støtte. Teksten innrømmer at ekstra bemanning koster penger. Den forutsetter at ansatte er tilgjengelige om kvelden.

piezas.explicacion: Model: separate the thesis, evidence, concession and assumed condition.
